def transform(grid):
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bg=max(set(x for row in grid for x in row),key=lambda x=sum(v==x for row in grid for v in row))
    # Recolor only missing background cells along rectangular object borders.
    for color in set(v for row in grid for v in row)-{bg}:
        cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==color]

        r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells)
        c0=min(c for r,c in cells); c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
        for r in range(r0,r1+1):
            for c in range(c0,c1+1):
                if grid[r][c]==bg and (r in (r0,r1) or c in (c0,c1)):
                    out[r][c]=7
    return out
